build_SSDHead: build an SSDHead instance with 80 classes and default anchor generator for object detection
create_SSDHead_depthwise: create an SSDHead with depthwise separable convolutions enabled for SSD-Lite architecture
run_SSDHead_forward: run the SSDHead forward pass on multi-scale feature maps to get cls_scores and bbox_preds
review_SSDHead_loss_by_feat: review the SSDHead loss_by_feat method that computes classification and regression losses across feature levels
refactor_SSDHead_loss_by_feat_single: refactor the SSDHead loss_by_feat_single method to use a different loss function than cross entropy
